what: The ring (SVG stroke) around the Back to top button is drawn by the fraction of the page scrolled — empty at the top, full at the bottom, shrinking again on the way up (no curve, exactly at the scroll position). Open-ended ring, circle or square outline, any stroke works at the same ratio without measuring its length

options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Line that fills up (path, circle, rect…) — not needed if the element itself is a line. If several, they fill together
options.from: Share already drawn at the start (0~1), default 0
options.dir: If ‹back›, it fills from the end of the line toward the start (default is start → end)

use: <button data-fx="scroll-ring" aria-label="Back to top"><svg viewBox="0 0 52 52"><circle data-fx-part="ring" cx="26" cy="26" r="19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"/></svg></button>

from.where: shared.js .dg-pagetop__ring — ring around the top-right ”Back to top” circle button, document top top → bottom bottom scrub (ease none)
